subject: CFStringEncoding

observation.tool_invocation:
grep -nE 'kCFStringEncoding[A-Za-z0-9]+ *=' /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/Headers/CFString.h
dyld_info -exports /System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation | grep -E '_kCFStringEncoding[A-Za-z0-9]*$'   # returns no rows
observation.summary: CFStringEncoding is a compile-time enum declared in the published CFString.h (MacRoman=0, Unicode/UTF16=0x0100, ASCII=0x0600, UTF8=0x08000100, UTF32=0x0c000100). The macOS 27 arm64e CoreFoundation export trie contains no _kCFStringEncoding* data symbol at all, so these values are link-time constants only.
observation.raw_output_excerpt:
CFString.h:113  kCFStringEncodingUTF8 = 0x08000100,
CFString.h:112  kCFStringEncodingUnicode = 0x0100,
export trie rows matching _kCFStringEncoding*: 0

claim: CFStringEncoding values are compile-time enum constants from the published CFString.h and have no corresponding exported data symbols in the macOS 27 arm64e CoreFoundation image.
